our_interpretation: The passage expresses a qualified concern about the economics of the proposed investment. It does not commit to a defined financial outcome.
Neither 'noticeably better' nor 'problematic' has a stated measurement or threshold.
Treating 'problematic' as failure to recover the investment with a commercial return over an assumed asset life would add commitments Marcus did not make.
The contextual 2028–2030 target concerns building the proposed project. It does not establish a deadline for judging its economics.
criteria.support_condition: No determinate support condition can be specified from these words alone. Higher operating costs or weak willingness to pay could substantiate the concern, but Marcus supplies no criterion making those observations sufficient to establish 'problematic' economics.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No determinate contradiction condition can be specified from these words alone. Positive returns or customer demand would not necessarily exclude economic difficulties, and Marcus does not define what would count as satisfactory economics.
